note: What a server sends to play a voice event. The header carries zero.

fields.name: event
fields.note: The event's name. A client sends no VoiceEventDone for a name that names no event it holds.

fields.name: callback
fields.note: Bit 0 set asks the client to send VoiceEventDone once the event has finished playing. A client sends it at once, whatever this holds, where its audio is not set up.

fields.name: folder
fields.note: The event's folder. It has no effect where kind is 1.

fields.name: event

fields.name: callback
